messages:
maria: vuln scanner flagged backup-uploader serviceAccount with KMS Decrypt on prod key. finding: privileged_grant -> serviceAccount:backup-uploader@redwood-prod.urgent on key prod-backups
kevin: confirmed; sec-scan v2 noticed Decrypts starting 2026-03-19. uploading logs to sec portal. link: https://sec-portal/reports/INC-2026-0427
sasha: tagging oncall. does uploader ever need Decrypt in prod? @devon?
devon: no — uploader should upload server-side encrypted blobs. looks like multi-region agent image did client-side encryption for staging and was promoted without switching mode.
maria: immediate mitigation:
 - revoke active grants for backup-uploader
 - deny kms:Decrypt for that principal, allow kms:Encrypt for staging only
 - consider CMK rotation if unauthorized decrypts confirmed
 - run canary restore to validate restore path
kevin: I'm revoking IAM binding now. examples:
`gcloud kms keys remove-iam-policy-binding prod-backups --location global --keyring backups --member="serviceAccount:backup-uploader@redwood-prod.urgent" --role="roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter"`
sasha: rolling back uploader image and pausing rollout. `kubectl -n backups set image deploy/uploader uploader=repo/uploader:v2026-03-12` then scale to 0.
encops-bot: Incident INC-2026-0427 created and routed to sec-eng, enc-ops. priority: high.
kevin: initial logs show 3 Decrypt calls over 48h for small metadata blobs. not clearly exfil. I'll correlate CloudTrail/Audit logs with pod logs.
devon: follow-up RBAC change: create `backup-restorer` role scoped to restore pipeline with strict resource/VPC conditions. will open PR.
maria: owners:
 - kevin: full correlation + decide on rotation (ETA 2h)
 - devon: terraform RBAC PR (ETA EOD)
 - sasha: verify no in-flight restores and run canary (ETA 4h)
encops-bot: INC-2026-0427 status -> mitigated (revoked grants, rollback). validation pending.
sasha: canary restore succeeded against snap-20260315-min. no data loss.
kevin: leaning not to rotate CMK unless evidence of exfil. will finalize after logs.
maria: update playbook and CI gating to prevent promotions with client-side KMS mode. add SIEM rule for kms:Decrypt by non-restorers. closing operational triage; follow-up in security backlog.
